result.reason: Although the cap is mutual and set at the preferred greater-of threshold, the clause retains an unconditional, Licensor-only exclusion for claims that use of the Licensed Technology infringes any person's rights. That provision conflicts with the stated IP-infringement carve-out and undermines mutuality and potentially indemnification liability. In addition, applying “EXCEPT FOR EXCLUDED CLAIMS” to the consequential-damages exclusion permits consequential damages for all carve-outs, whereas the playbook expressly describes those claims only as uncapped; this goes beyond what is clearly required. The lookback also runs from the event giving rise to the claim rather than the claim itself. The retained run-on language, typo (“LICENSORHAS”), and internal inconsistency materially reduce drafting quality.
